app.tagline: See how the sky changes over time

search.label: Object name or coordinates
search.notConnected: Search will be connected in the next release. Only the interface is ready for now.

hero.heading: SPHEREx re-maps the whole sky every six months
hero.body: SPHEREx surveys the entire sky in 102 colours (spectral channels) between 0.75 and 5 µm. Comparing images of the same region taken at different dates reveals comets, asteroids and fast-moving nearby stars as they change position.
hero.step1: Type an object name or coordinates
hero.step3: See the change with blink and difference images
hero.honest: A SPHEREx image is not a single-colour photograph: the wavelength changes from one edge of the image to the other. The site shows this clearly on every screen.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.summary: This site records anonymous usage events to understand how it is used (e.g. which page was opened, which object was searched).
privacy.details: Recorded: a random session id, event type and time, searched object, browser family (e.g. "chrome") and a salted hash of your IP address that changes every day. The IP address itself is never stored. Records are deleted after 90 days. If you create an account, your e-mail is used only to send login codes. Data is not shared with third parties.
privacy.essentialNote: With "Essential only" no usage events are sent; the site still works fully.
